Master will commit the M3 contract/index/relations/ledger kickoff before dispatch; the resulting kickoff SHA is the worker base. All13 Slices and all143 baseline findings remain in scope.

Parent #21; M3 Git adapter contribution, opened/dispatched only after complete independently accepted/integrated M2 Domain/API/ports/viewmodel surfaces and their exact canonical CI. Master records actual base/source/BC authority in the created Issue. Read AGENTS/developmentInstructions completely, full #21 and this Issue, accepted Git review #31, REFDES/API/Storage/Cwd/WindowsBroker where referenced, exact MigrationMap/Slices/Verification/FindingDisposition, all frozen relevant BCs especially Application--Git G1..G12 and shared BoundaryTypes, plus actual accepted Domain/API/ports code and M1 enforcement.

Fresh Worker owns only new internal/git/ adapter/private helpers/tests/README and bounded SDP/Implementation/CR-#21/Git/M3-Git--001.md report. Dedicated codereview-21/layer-git worktree from accepted M2 kickoff. No legacy app/worktree/graph/diff/process sources, other concrete adapters, shared module/workflow, accepted design/frozen BC or Master metadata edits. No forced branch history rewrite, tag/publication or product PR is authorized. Verification uses owned temporary repositories/worktrees/bare remotes and does not mutate user repositories or user/global configuration. Never expose credentials or private user repository/configuration data in public diagnostics. Master coordinates any truly needed shared change and separate fresh Reviewer.

Implement all exact GitFacts and GitMutations port methods and typed fact/result families, not wrappers over old code. Physical LocalCommon/worktree identity, primary/current/linked/availability, actual Head Attached/Detached/Unborn, occupancy/status/index/path facts, scoped remote bindings/capabilities/freshness, refs/exact resolution, stash/history/graph/diff/PR merge-base/StashPatch and bounded pagination/patch diagnostics must conform to the accepted APIs. No GitHub calls/joins, active preference selection, Runtime session ownership or App workflow in Git. Names are locator metadata; exact selected Revision and repository scope remain authoritative. Native branch ref construction uses the accepted literal Domain suffix exactly once and applies native creation restrictions separately.

Cooperating Git mutations serialize per LocalCommon repository through both an adapter-owned in-process scheduler and the G7 cross-process scope lock. Acquire that scope guard first, then remaining native guards nonblockingly in the frozen documented order; release only owned locks. No locks survive across user confirmation.

Eight typed prepare plans/private issuer/registry/continuation receipts obey operation/kind/version/source/origin/choice binding, bounded lifetimes, release/replay rules and no native locks/resources held during user confirmation. Application sequences stash-then-deploy, pop and stage-all commit; Git may only advance verified authorized own predecessor facets, never renew stale consent from current state.

Implement the full frozen native preparation/publication protocols G8..G10 and commit G8a, consuming accepted archived feasibility evidence as design inputs, not product tests: standalone scratch native preparation with copied—not linked—live input; native-supported index/attributes/config; capture real originals and verify captured identities; no-replace publication and retained original/installed payload objects; protected index/ref/registration/journal/recovery stages; create-only recovery refs. Every live worktree rewrite is covered, not only restore. No unchecked live checkout/reset/clean, generic hand-written ref backend, positional destructive stash operation, automatic replay or loss of dirty/untracked/late-writer bytes. Supported Git/filesystem/config/signing profiles are proved; unsupported profiles explicitly refuse without claiming unchanged auxiliary effects.

Commit preserves real hook/signer context, native cleanup/parent/tree semantics and later message-hook staging as a final index distinct from the new commit tree. The native HEAD-first prepared ref transaction locks the actual branch/head and validates expected mode/name/OID, including unborn and same-OID branch drift; protected index publication precedes final ref commit, and no later index/worktree publication overwrites committed/post-commit hook edits. Real signing profiles need actual proof; the archived signer fixture was noncryptographic. Stash exact OID/occurrence and narrow files-backend drop journal preserve survivor bytes/order, packed/last-entry behavior and A-B-A protection; reftable/unknown deletion profiles refuse. Pull is exact guarded fast-forward; push pinned nonforce with independent LocalConfiguration/upstream outcome.

Command cancellation is not rollback. Preserve typed known/partial/indeterminate effects, diagnostics, recovery IDs/locators/versions and result-plus-error facts, bounded root reaping/output/cleanup/reconciliation and no unsafe retry. Normal root-only CommandContext cannot claim Runtime descendant guarantees; actual residual uncertainty is retained. Use accepted source/profile budgets and no unbounded memory/event/command drain.

Provide a check-to-evidence map for all Git-owned obligations in V-GIT-01..10 and the related V-DOM/V-APP/V-GH/V-COMP/Slice boundary clauses at exact source. Keep dependent Application and full-stack portions explicitly pending for M4/M5/M6/final integrated verification; this does not waive any Git-owned native requirement. Use real temporary SHA-1/SHA-256 repositories, linked worktrees and clones, bare remotes, shifted/duplicate stashes, stale exact targets, path/attribute/index/ref races, held-open writes, native hooks/signing, crash/failure/cancel points, truthful recovery and resource results. Native Windows/Linux/macOS path/index/ref/hook proof and all12 builds remain required; additional supported filesystem/native profiles are explicit. The archived G8a HEAD-first commit mechanism ran on Git2.43 as well as2.48.1; the newer tested2.48.1 executable supplies G9's affected attach/symref transitions. Preserve reads and other supported capabilities on each profile, refusing only unsupported operations by capability. Inspect the portable fixture as evidence, never hardcode its developer-local path into product or use a symbolic-ref fallback/unrecorded version assumption. Actual CI Git versions are recorded.

Worker freezes/pushes complete bounded source with real local/CI/native evidence and limits. Separate fresh reviewer reopens code/tests/contracts/SHAs, reproduces meaningful adverse controls, correct/re-review, require current branch CI. Master serially integrates Git first among M3 adapters and records exact source/review/integration/native evidence. No complete Slice or baseline finding is closed solely from an adapter folder passing tests; full new-stack M5/M6/final verification remains required. 

Master tooling preparation at312b5343405f5e7a928e0f1d2f5e93aeb363972f (Tooling-Preparation--001) proves local native SSH/OpenPGP signatures and tamper rejection for both object formats with isolated fixtures. Consume only as tool setup evidence, not adapter or G8a bridge acceptance. Bundled MSYS GPG used a /c/... GNUPGHOME; native SHA256 signature field is gpgsig-sha256, so do not hardcode SHA1 parsing. Original environment/assertion failures and hashes remain archived.

Implementation evidence must map each layer-owned clause to actual source/tests/platforms. Dependent Application/State/View/full-stack portions remain explicit later gates; this does not waive any native requirement owned by this contribution. Master alone declares contribution/Slice completion from independent review and verified integration.

The final M2 governance checkpoint3cf264141764385eb6afe3f7e4e25a7504020690 also passed exact CI34047530046 (18 applicable SUCCESS/explicit pre-Runtime M3 skip). The superseded documentation run34047480826 was canceled and is not passing evidence.
